test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The list price of an article is Rs. 1,200 and a discount of 15% is offered on the list price. What additional discount per cent on the already discounted price must be offered to a customer to bring the net selling price to Rs. 887.40?
solution:
**Given:**

 The list price of an article is Rs. 1,200 a discount of 15% is offered on the list price.

**Calculation:**

L.P. = List Price, S.P. = Selling Price

L.P. = Rs 1200 and Discount = 15%

⇒ S.P. = 85% of Rs 1200 = 85over100 times 1200 = 1020

Final S.P. = Rs 887.40

⇒ Additional discount = Rs. 1020 - Rs. 887.40 = Rs. 132.6

⇒Additional discount = 132.6over1020 times100 = 13 %

** Additional discount per cent on the already discounted price must be offered to a customer to bring the net selling price to Rs. 887.40 is '13%'.**
